competitive_advantages.title: Vector-Powered Semantic Cruise Search
competitive_advantages.description: Replace keyword-based filtering with natural language semantic search using embeddings (pgvector/Pinecone). Users can type 'romantic balcony cabin for anniversary under $4000' and get relevant results ranked by semantic similarity.
competitive_advantages.competitive_moat: High - Difficult to replicate, requires ML infrastructure and training data
competitive_advantages.user_impact: Transformative - Changes how users discover cruises

competitive_advantages.title: Real-Time Webhook Price Alerts with ML Predictions
competitive_advantages.description: Move beyond email alerts. Offer WebSocket/SSE-based real-time push notifications when prices drop, plus ML-powered predictions on when to book (buy/wait signals based on historical price patterns).
competitive_advantages.competitive_moat: Medium - Requires pricing history data and ML pipeline
competitive_advantages.user_impact: High - Core retention driver for deal-conscious users

competitive_advantages.title: All-Inclusive Transparent Pricing Engine
competitive_advantages.description: Display the true total cost including all taxes, port fees, and surcharges before the user clicks through. CruisePlum and competitors typically show base fares and reveal fees later. Calculate and display all-in pricing with booking fee estimates.
technical_stack: Partner API integration for fee data
competitive_advantages.competitive_moat: Medium - Requires partnership/API access to fee data
competitive_advantages.user_impact: High - Directly addresses #1 consumer complaint in cruise booking

competitive_advantages.title: Interactive Price History & Prediction Charts
competitive_advantages.description: Replace static pricing with interactive D3.js/Chart.js price history charts showing price trends over time, lowest recorded prices, price predictions, and 'buy zone' indicators. Users can see if a deal is actually a deal.
competitive_advantages.competitive_moat: Low-Medium - Visual but can be copied

competitive_advantages.title: Multi-Platform Native Experience (PWA + Mobile Apps)
competitive_advantages.description: Deliver a full Progressive Web App with offline search, push notifications, and install prompts, plus React Native apps for iOS/Android with shared business logic. CruisePlum shows no evidence of native mobile strategy.
competitive_advantages.implementation_effort: High (6-8 weeks PWA, 10-12 weeks native apps)
competitive_advantages.user_impact: High - Opens mobile app store discovery and re-engagement

competitive_advantages.title: Personalized Cruise Recommender Engine
competitive_advantages.description: ML-powered recommendation system that learns from user behavior (browsing history, saved cruises, past bookings) to deliver personalized cruise suggestions. Uses collaborative filtering + content-based approaches.
competitive_advantages.competitive_moat: High - Requires user base and purchase data to train effectively

competitive_advantages.title: One-Click Fare Comparison Across Cabin Types
competitive_advantages.description: Side-by-side comparison of all cabin types (Inside, Oceanview, Balcony, Suite) with price differences, amenities, and availability all on one screen. Modern UI with interactive cabin maps and 360° virtual tours.
